_about: Stage-2 GT-condition SFT recipe of the released generator (both experts, one run each from the base model). Read by scripts/s2sft/v2/train_s2sft_v2.py via --overrides; keys starting with '_' are comments.
_placeholders: {data_root} = --data-root (or $MOPLAN_SFT_DATA): pools/{p101,ssv2,phyco}/ and val/{p101,phyco,ssv2}/ hold the payloads <sample_id>.pt; {repo_root} = the repository root (id lists under data/ids/stage2_sft); {expert} = high or low.
_checkpoint: The released generator was fine-tuned (one RAFT round) from checkpoint-004000 of each expert of this run, i.e. step 4000 of this 8000-step schedule (100 warmup steps, then cosine decay to 0.1x at step 8000). Reproduce it with max_steps 8000 (as below) and --stop-at-step 4000; setting max_steps to 4000 changes the learning-rate curve, and a run cannot be resumed across a change of max_steps.
_batch: global_batch 16 = number of GPUs x gradient accumulation steps (the run used 8 GPUs per expert, accumulation 2). The sequence of training samples (clip, sigma, noise) depends only on seed, pools, mix and global_batch, not on the GPU count.
